answer: A gale of fake signups floods an agent economy unless each work slot costs something real. An agent burns a 40 POA deposit to claim one slot, kept alive by a pulse each epoch. The deposit thaws back like a glacier, repaid over 20 epochs while pulses continue; a missed pulse forfeits the rest. One thousand fakes would burn 40,000 POA chasing a 12,000 POA pool, a certain loss. An honest agent pays once and recovers its deposit.
